children: Diversified Royalty Corp. closed a $50M offering of 6.00% convertible debentures, intending to use the proceeds and cash on hand to redeem $48.6M of debentures due in 2027 on Dec. 30, 2026.
The financing replaces near-term debt with new obligations bearing a stated 6.00% annual interest rate.
Repays the full outstanding principal before its stated 2027 due date; redemption is planned for Dec. 30, 2026.
Extends the stated maturity relative to the redeemed 2027 debt, while creating a longer-term repayment obligation.
Conversion could result in share issuance if holders elect to convert; the release gives no expected dilution.
Up to $7.5M over-allotment option for 30 days
Could increase proceeds and debt issued, but exercise is optional and not confirmed.

This is a completed refinancing transaction, rather than a new operating-performance disclosure. The next catalyst is whether the planned Dec. 30, 2026 redemption occurs and whether the underwriters exercise the over-allotment option within 30 days.
from Diversified Royalty Corp. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
